alerts.title: Just a weak mental in this new season
alerts.summary: https://preview.redd.it/ifmx1vn45o1i1.png?width=3777&format=png&auto=webp&s=2ad97684b6f48f97fc588d8838356a7268b94e13 I have been doing some placements in comp (this game is around gm3 to diamond 1), and I just am baffled at the absolute weak mental of my team. Im the only one using my mic, my rocket was getting dove by spiderman and I keep telling them to wait for me so i can bring them back to team fight around second point. We get it past second although we used a lot of ults, so i tell my team to play more passive, we get our ults and the white fox/luna (jeff in scorecard) uses theirs, and the other supports use theirs. Its OT and my rocket (peni at end) decides to not use their ult, my bucky then flames them and I tell him to calm down and then tell the rocket "hey can you go like invis or luna?" they then flash a invis woman (they have 100+ hours on btw), so i say "great! new round lets win!" my bucky then decides to flame them for staying rocket against a diving spiderman (I agree with the fact it was dumb of them, but the way he said it was rude), which then prompts the invis/rocket to go peni. My bucky then says he doesnt mind losing and puts in a forfeit, everyone but me hits accept and we lose, it was so winnable too. I just dont understand the mental of these people on how they just throw on a whim, how is it fun? Not to be rude to the other team but they were not the greatest and we would have won if we just were not dying to dive (possible by rocket going invis).
